title: Premiering Sunday
subtitle: Special guest Fredrick Brennan.
text:
Tune in on Clubhouse at 2pm EDT on Sunday May 16th for the premiere of The Frontier Psychiatrists Daily - your daily destination for what’s next in mental health, stigma free and evidence based. We will be joined by 8chan founder (and later, renouncer), fontographer and reluctant hero Fredrick Brennan. We will explore the reasons people form online communities and grapple with what fosters connection and trust rather than hate and violence in these spaces.
